part1_question.question_text: Is MFA enforced for M365 admin roles?
part1_question.detail_prompt: If yes or partial, specify the tool or technology in use.

questions.text: How frequently are M365 admin role assignments reviewed?
What process triggers DMARC, DKIM, and SPF configuration updates?
expected_evidence_types: DMARC, DKIM, and SPF DNS record output

questions.text: How are external sharing restrictions enforced in SharePoint and OneDrive?
expected_evidence_types: External sharing report from SharePoint and OneDrive

questions.text: What is the frequency of DLP policy reviews and updates?
expected_evidence_types: DLP policy export and sensitivity label configuration

questions.text: How are OAuth app permissions reviewed and approved?

maturity_guide.mature: M365 tenant is fully configured against a security baseline, with minimized admin roles, restricted global admin use, and enabled Microsoft Defender for Office 365. DMARC, DKIM, and SPF are configured and enforced for all sending domains, with fully configured anti-phishing, safe links, and safe attachments. External sharing in SharePoint and OneDrive is governed and restricted, with configured and enforced DLP policies and enabled M365 audit logs.
maturity_guide.partial: M365 tenant has some security baseline configurations in place, but admin roles are not fully minimized, and global admin use is not restricted. DMARC, DKIM, and SPF are partially configured, with some anti-phishing, safe links, and safe attachments settings in place. External sharing in SharePoint and OneDrive is partially governed, with some DLP policies configured, but M365 audit logs are not fully enabled.
maturity_guide.critical_gap: M365 tenant has no security baseline configurations in place, with unrestricted admin roles and global admin use, leaving the organization vulnerable to email-based attacks and data breaches.

evidence_to_request: DMARC, DKIM, and SPF DNS record output for all sending domains
Email filtering configuration summary showing safe links, safe attachments, and anti-phishing settings
User phishing report submission log and review process documentation
External sharing report from SharePoint and OneDrive showing active external shares

red_flags.critical_gap: M365 tenant has no enabled Microsoft Defender for Office 365, leaving the organization vulnerable to email-based attacks.
red_flags.recommended_action: Enable Microsoft Defender for Office 365 and configure anti-phishing, safe links, and safe attachments settings.

red_flags.critical_gap: Admin roles are not minimized, and global admin use is not restricted, increasing the risk of privilege escalation attacks.
red_flags.recommended_action: Minimize admin roles and restrict global admin use to prevent privilege escalation attacks.

red_flags.critical_gap: External sharing in SharePoint and OneDrive is not governed and restricted, increasing the risk of data breaches.
red_flags.recommended_action: Govern and restrict external sharing in SharePoint and OneDrive to prevent data breaches.
